newsitem.title: USA: Giga-tronics says sales may continue lower.
newsitem.headline: Giga-tronics says sales may continue lower.

text.p: Giga-tronics Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Officer George Bruns said Wednesday there is no assurance that the current level of sales will increase in the near term, and earnings may suffer.
The company reported net income for the fiscal fourth quarter ended March 29 of $198,000 on sales of $6.3 million, down from net income of $302,000 on sales of $7.8 million a year earlier.

Bruns said the company's underlying fiscal position remains strong and "it intends to increase product development expenditures substantially in the near term for the purpose of broadening its product base and accelerating internal growth."
Giga-tronics designs, manufactures and markets microwave and RF signal generation and power measurement instruments.
